gamePicks.why: Model lean, published on our number alone. Our total is 55.9 against 61: the under reads 54.0% after the raw 61.2% is shrunk by the model's record against the close, +1.9 points clear of the 52.2% that -109 needs. The projection is the reason for this lean. Verified statistical reporting also points against this side; see the counterpoints below. Checked before publishing: Arizona coach Brent Brennan confirmed that starting receiver Tre Spivey will miss the rest of the season with a foot injury. The total opened 58.5 and is 61.5 at DraftKings, 3 toward the over. 6 books span 3 to 3.5 on the spread; the middle is 3.5. 6 books span 61 to 61.5 on the total; the middle is 61.5. gamePicks.risk: Statistical counterpoint: Arizona says its offense has converted third downs at a 57.8% rate this season. Historical stats remain context, not a separate injury or availability hold. It rests on the model alone, and the closing line beats our number on average, so a gap this size is more often our error than the market's. Confidence 2 of 10.
